# WebMD Doctor

> > WebMD's comprehensive physician and hospital directory connecting patients with healthcare providers across the United States through searchable profiles, ratings, and specialty-based filtering.

WebMD Doctor is the primary destination for patients seeking to find and compare physicians, hospitals, and group practices. The platform integrates physician profiles, hospital rankings, and quality metrics to help patients make informed healthcare decisions.

## Key Topics

- WebMD
- WebMD Choice Awards
- WebMD Care
- Physician Directory
- Doctor Search
- Hospital Finder
- Medical Specialties
- Cardiology
- Oncology
- Hospital Ratings
- Healthcare Providers
- Patient Ratings
- Specialty Care
- Healthcare Quality
- Appointment Booking

## Physician & Provider Search

- [Find Doctors Near You: Top Physician Directory](https://doctor.webmd.com): WebMD physician directory homepage for searching doctors by specialty, insurance, and location.
- [WebMD Physician Directory - Find a Doctor in Your Area](https://doctor.webmd.com/results): WebMD physician search results page with doctor education, practice info, and insurance details.

## Hospital & Facility Finder

- [Best Hospitals in the United States | WebMD Choice Awards](https://doctor.webmd.com/choice-awards): WebMD Choice Awards ranking best US hospitals in cardiology, oncology, and other specialties.
- [Find the best hospitals | WebMD Care](https://doctor.webmd.com/hospitals): WebMD hospital finder directory with reviews, hours, and affiliated doctors by state.
- [Find the best group practices | WebMD Care](https://doctor.webmd.com/grouppractices): WebMD group practices directory searchable by state including California, Texas, New York, Florida.

## For Healthcare Providers

- [Grow Your Practice with WebMD + Vitals.com - the #1 Online Health Network](https://doctor.webmd.com/claim/learnmore): WebMD physician profile management and practice growth tools via Vitals.com integration.
